book.name: MADIU
book.title: Rongamwahu me Ntingdier sang rehn MADIU

content: Padahk en mehn Mahs ako
Eri, Parisi kei oh sounkawehwehn Kosonnedo kei ahpw pwarodo sang Serusalem, re ahpw kalelapak rehn Sises, patohwan,
“Dahme sapwellimomwi tohnpadahk kan kin mwamwahlikihki tiahk kodoudou sang samatail mehn mahs ako, ni ar sohte kin omwiomw mwohn ar kin mwenge?”
Sises ketin sapeng irail, mahsanih, “A kumwail dahme kumwail pil kin mwamwahlikihki kosonned en Koht, pwe kumwail en dadaur pein amwail tiahk kan?
Pwe Koht ketin mahsanih, ‘Ke en kahkahki semomw oh inomw’, oh ‘Mehmen me pahn lahlahwe seme de ine pahn kamakamala’.
A kumwail ahpw kin padahngkihwei ma mehmen me ahneki mehkot me e kak sewesehki seme de ine, e ahpw nda, ‘Met sapwellimen Koht,’
dene e solahr pahn kahkahki seme. Eri, ih duwen amwail kin mwamwahliki mahsen en Koht pwe kumwail en daur pein amwail tiahk kan.
Mwalaun amwailen! Melelete pwe e uhdahn pwungiong kumwail me soukohp Aiseia kohpadahro, me mahsanih,

content.text: ‘Koht mahsanih, aramas pwukat kin kahkahkin ie arail lokaiahte,
a kapehdirail kan me inenen dohsang ie.
Sohte katepen ar kin pwongih ie,
pwehki re kin padahngkihwei kosonned en aramas dene e pwilisang rehn Koht!’”

content: Dahme kin Kasaminehla Aramas
Sises ketin malipepene aramas ako oh mahsanihong irail, “Kumwail rong oh dehdehki mwahu met:
kaidehkin me kohieng nan ewen aramas me kin kasaminehla, pwe me kin kohsang nan ewe.”
Tohnpadahk ko eri keiong mpe oh patohwanohng, “Komw mwahngih duwen Parisi ko ar mwakarkidahr me komw ahpwtehn mahsanihen?”
A e ketin sapeng irail, mahsanih, “Tuhke koaros me Semei me ketiket nanleng sohte ketin padokedi, pahn usuhsdahsang.
Kumwail dehr nsenohkin irail; pwe sounkaweid maskun kei irail. Eri, ma sounkaweid maskun men pahn kahluwa emen maskun, ira koaros pahn pwupwudiong nan pwoahr.”
Piter eri patohwanohng, “Maing, komw ketin kawehwehiong kiht karasaras pwoaten.”
A Sises ketin mahsanih, “Da? Kumwail saikinte marainla duwehte meteiko?
Kumwail sehse me mehkoaros me kin kohlong nan ewen aramas, kin kohdihla nan kapehde, oh ahpw kin kohieisang ni paliwere?
A mehkan me kin kohieisang nan ewe, kin tepisang nan kapehde, oh ih me kin kasaminehla aramas.
Pwe lamalam suwed kan kin pwilisang nan kapehd en aramas oh kin kahrehda kamaramas, kamwahl, nenek, pirap, likamw, oh karaun likamw ape.
Ih soahng pwukat me kin kasaminehla aramas; a kaidehkin mwenge ahpw sohte omwiomw.”
En Lih Emen Eh Pwoson
Sises eri ketiketla sang wasao, ketiketlahng wasa kis limwahn kahnimw en Dair oh Saidon.

A iet lihen Kenan men, me kin koukousoan wasao, ahpw pwarala reh, ngihl laudida, patohwanohng, “Maing, komwi me kisehn kadaudok en Depit, komw ketin kupwure ie mahs. Nei serepein men mie me ngehn suwed tiadahr powe; e kin mihmi nan apwal laud.”
A Sises sohte mwahn ketin sapeng. Sapwellime tohnpadahk ko ahpw keiong mpe oh ngidingid, patohwanohng, “Komw ketin kadarala mahs lihen pwe me kedirepw, pwe e weriwer kohdo mwuritail!”
A Sises ketin sapeng, “Ngehi I pekederdohngete rehn sihpwen wehin Israel ko me salongalahr.”
A liho keilahngete kelepwikihdiong mwohn aluweluwe kan, patohwan, “Maing, komw ketin sewese ie!”
A Sises mahsanih, “E sohte konehng kihsang kenen seri kan kanarail mwenge oh keselahng kidi kan.”
A liho patohwanohng, “Mehlel, Maing; ahpw kidi kan pil kin kang mweremwer en kisin mwenge kan me kin pwupwudihsang nin tehpel en ar soumas akan.”
Sises eri ketin sapeng, mahsanihong, “Eri, lih! Omw pwosonen me laud! E pahn wiawihong uhk duwen me ke inengieng.” Ni ahnsowohte nah serepeino pa kehlailda.
Sises ketin Kakehlahda Aramas Tohto
Sises eri ketiketla sang wasao, ketin peianla oaroahr en Lehen Kalili. E ahpw ketidahla pohn dohl ehu oh ketidiong wasao.

Lapalahn pokon ahpw kohpene reh, ekei me wa me nehtuk kei, a ekei kahre me maskun kei, a ekei me dengideng, a ekei me lohteng kei, oh soangen soumwahu tohto teikan, re ahpw kin pwilikihdiong mwohn aluweluwe kan; e ahpw kin ketin kakehleirailda.

Pokono ahpw kin pwuriamweikihla ar kin kilangada duwen me lohteng kan ar kin lokaiahda, me poakolong kan ar mwahula, me nehtuk kan ar kin aluhki neh pokon, oh me maskun kan ar kin kilangada wasa; re ahpw kin kapikapingahki Koht en Israel.
Sises ketin Katungoalehda Aramas Pahkid

Sises eri ketin malipepene sapwellime tohnpadahk ko oh mahsanihong irail, “I poakelahr pokon wet, pwe rahnehr siluh me re mihmihki rehi, oh met solahr kanarail kisin mwenge. A I sohte men kadarirailpeseng, nan ar sohte mwenge, pwe re de kohpeseng oh lipwongmasala nanial akan.”
Tohnpadahk ko ahpw patohwanohng, “Se pahn patohwan sang ia kisin sak nan sapwtehn wet me pahn itar ong pokon wet?”
Sises eri keinemwe rehrail, mahsanih, “Lopwon en pilawa depe mie rehmwail?” A irail patohwanohng, “Me isuh, oh pil kisin mwomw kei.”
Sises eri mahsanihong pokono en mwohndiong nanpwel.
Ih eri ketin ale lopwon isuhwo oh kisin mwomw ko, oh loulouki; e ahpw ketin pilitikipeseng oh ketikihong sapwellime tohnpadahk ko, tohnpadahk ko ahpw uhd nehkohng pokono.
Irail koaros eri kepin konot oh medla. Tohnpadahk ko ahpw deukada luhwen konoto oh kadirehla kopwou isuh.
Tohtohn ohl me iang kepin konot wet me pahkid, lih oh seri kan sohte iang wadawadohng.
Sises eri ketin kadarihrpeseng; e ahpw ketidahng pohn pwoht ehu oh sipallahng limwahn Makadan.
